text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! This is delicious, Trainer!
I feel like I could eat this forever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The inn she had helped out with feng shui before.
Out of gratitude, the folks there
had invited us to a campsite.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My tummy's full!
Alright, time to absorb plenty of nature's qi and refresh myself!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, so fast!
I can see its shadow, but it won't take the bi—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh!? I got a bite!
Today's lucky food!
Trainer, the net! The net~~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Trainer!
You can see Mt. Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Mount Fuji is a Dragon Hole, you know! It's an auspicious place that sends good ki flowing straight to Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! Looking at it makes me really wanna climb it!
Trainer, let's go give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just kidding!
But let's definitely go someday!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was fun!
I guess it's about time to head home—

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text: Wait, so it's my fault?!

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You looked so gloomy the whole time...
I didn't have fun at aaaaall today!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An angry shout suddenly rang out.
Startled, I looked over to see that some of the guests appeared to be fighting...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...From a feng shui perspective, the cottage those two are staying in might not be great.
It sits right at a T-junction, so negative energy is colliding straight into it.
choice_data_list: Then maybe feng shui could change that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might be able to help resolve awkward situations,
just like the one at the inn.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Alright, let's Copa through this one too☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Please don't fight, you two!
Why don't we try changing rooms? Feng shui-wise, you know—

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest B
text_block_list.text:
What is this, all of a sudden?!
This has nothing to do with you, so butt out!

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, stay out of this!
This is our problem!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the customer said made complete sense.
Copano Rickey was being meddlesome,
and there was no need for her to butt in... and yet.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to energize everyone with feng shui!
For that, I can work as hard as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She just wants everyone to smile.
She wants every single person here to have fun.
That's why...
choice_data_list: Could you listen to what this child has to say for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Hotel Guest A
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? First that girl, now you... What on earth is with you guys?
choice_data_list: I just don't want you to be left with bad memories

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's right!
Let's have a fun camping trip!
I want to help out with that!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You know, depending on the building,
there are places where people tend to clash.
In this case—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for today!
I'm so glad those two calmed down~!
choice_data_list: Great work again today, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, it's thanks to you, Trainer!
I was so happy you believed in me back then!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You know, you were so reassuring! And you looked super cool!! Really, truly!
choice_data_list: Because I thought you'd figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Thanks for trusting me so much!
Leave it to Feng Shui Master Rickey from now on too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Copano Rickey puffing out her chest with pride made me realize that seeing her full of energy suits her best.
It turned into a wonderful memory.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that so?
...Ehehe, actually, same here.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer worked really hard for it!
Thanks to that, we solved it, so everything's totally, Copa-fectly okay! Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How quickly she bounces back might just be part of her charm.
With that thought in mind, fond memories blossomed into conversation...
